content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Administrative Assistant at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: IIT Jammu (client organization); engagement through outsource agency M/s Nimbus Harbor Pvt. Ltd.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Postgraduate in any discipline from a Govt. recognized University or Institute with at least 60% marks in aggregate or equivalent grade. Desirable: Master of Business Administration from a Govt. recognized University or Institute. 1 year of experience in a reputed organization. Age limit: 40 years. The notice does not print a date for counting age and lists no age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated salary package is 28,000 – 35,700 per month, and the period of engagement is 06 months. The notice states that this is purely a temporary engagement. Selection does not entitle a candidate to any claim for regularization against any regular post, or any vacancy arising in future in this or any cadre/post, on the basis of this service at IIT Jammu. M/s Nimbus Harbor Pvt. Ltd. will depute the selected candidate at IIT Jammu on outsource basis.

content_sections.heading: IIT Jammu Administrative Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Attend departmental meetings and record the minutes; prepare, distribute and maintain records of meeting minutes. Follow up on action items and ensure timely completion of tasks discussed in meetings. Assist in the preparation, submission and tracking of student requests for department members. Ensure all documents are completed accurately and submitted within deadlines. Maintain organized and up-to-date filing systems for all departmental documents, including correspondence, reports and records. Ensure easy retrieval of documents as needed by department members. Maintenance of student data, academic data on Excel. Digitalize and archive older documents when necessary. Coordinate logistics for departmental events, seminars and conferences. Handle incoming and outgoing communications, including emails and phone calls. Assist with any other administrative tasks as assigned by the HoDs or other senior staff. Be flexible and ready to take on additional tasks or projects as required to support the department's goals and objectives.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Jammu Administrative Assistant
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to submit the online application latest by 03.12.2026. The steps it gives are: Visit https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in , which is used on behalf of the outsource agency for wider reach, to submit the application. Provide complete information, because incomplete information shall be summarily rejected. Provide proof of 10th or equivalent, graduation and post-graduation qualification, Ph.D. (if any), experience, and last salary drawn. Documents named in the notice: Proof of 10th or equivalent Graduation and post-graduation qualification Ph.D. (if any) Experience Last salary drawn All original documents, to be brought for verification during Trade Test/Interaction

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Mere fulfilling the minimum qualifications may not ensure short-listing, and a higher criterion may be adopted for calling a reasonable number of candidates. Candidates must bring all original documents for verification during Trade Test/Interaction; candidates without original certificates will not be entertained. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.
